metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting air and somehow landed a kill? Valorant’s glitch is wild!
metadata.description:
Me: No clue what I aimed at
Enemy: Probably uninstalling in disbelief
Valorant’s logic just handed me a kill like a prank
Click if your aim’s a beautiful disaster too!

Tap if your best kills come from pure chaos!

#valorant #luckykill #gamingfails #funnygaming #shorts
